category.name: Video generation and editing
category.description: Text/image-to-video models, talking avatars, programmatic video rendering and video hosting.

entries.name: Akool API
entries.auth_hint: x-api-key: <api_key> (recommended); the Client ID/Secret token flow is kept only for backward compatibility
entries.free_tier: Paid only for API: API access starts at the Pro Max plan; the Free plan is web-app only with full-screen watermark
entries.desc_en: Generate face-swap, talking avatar, and video-translation content programmatically via REST API.
entries.notes: Credit-based usage across face swap, avatar video, image generation, video translation endpoints.

call.async: poll GET https://openapi.akool.com/api/open/v3/content/video/infobymodelid?video_model_id={_id} until video_status=3 (4=failed); video URL valid 7 days

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Creatomate API
entries.free_tier: Trial: full-featured trial with 50 credits one-time on signup, no credit card required; then Essential plan with 2,000 credits/mo
entries.desc_en: Programmatically generate and render videos/images from templates via REST API.
entries.notes: Per-project API keys; ~14 credits per minute of 720p video. The hosted MCP accepts OAuth or a Bearer project API key.

rate_limits.summary: 30 requests per 10 seconds per account (all projects); 429 with Retry-After

async_jobs.how: POST /v2/renders returns 202; poll GET /v2/renders/{id} or pass webhook_url

data_policy.summary: Rendered output files are hosted for up to 30 days, then deleted

call.operation: render a video from a template
call.async: poll GET https://api.creatomate.com/v2/renders/{id} until status is succeeded (url then points to the file), or pass webhook_url

unit_price.summary: 1 image = 1 credit; 1 minute of 720p/25fps video = about 14 credits; credits from $29/mo for 2,000 (Essential, about $0.0145 per credit)

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: D-ID API
entries.free_tier: Trial: 14 days with 3 minutes of video credits, then paid plans only (API price per minute not published in machine-readable form)
entries.desc_en: Animate photos into talking-head videos with lip-sync from text or audio via REST API.
entries.notes: No permanent free plan; trial has full-screen watermark.

async_jobs.how: POST /talks returns id; poll GET /talks/{id} until status done, or set webhook

call.operation: create a talking-head video from a photo and text
call.example: curl -X POST https://api.d-id.com/talks -H "Authorization: Basic $DID_API_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"source_url":"https://d-id-public-bucket.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/alice.jpg","script":{"type":"text","input":"Making videos is easy with D-ID"}}'
call.async: poll GET https://api.d-id.com/talks/{id} until status is done, then read result_url

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Google Veo (Gemini API / Vertex AI)
entries.auth_hint: Gemini API: x-goog-api-key header or ?key= param. Vertex AI alternative uses cloud_iam (service-account OAuth2 access token).
entries.free_tier: no free tier for video; Veo generation requires a paid Gemini API / Vertex AI billing account
entries.desc_en: Generate video from text or image prompts via Gemini API (api key) or Vertex AI (cloud IAM), incl. Veo 3.1 scene extension.
entries.notes: Same underlying model reachable via two auth paths: Gemini API (simple api_key, good for agents) or Vertex AI (cloud_iam, enterprise/region control). Experimental vendor MCP mcp-veo-go (Genmedia) uses Vertex AI via ADC.

rate_limits.summary: Limits depend on project usage tier (Free, Tier 1-3); Veo-specific limits shown in AI Studio rate-limit dashboard

async_jobs.how: POST models/{model}:predictLongRunning returns an operation name; poll GET /{operation_name} until done

data_policy.summary: Generated videos are stored on the server for 2 days

call.async: Response returns an operation `name`; poll GET https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/{name} (x-goog-api-key header) until `done` is true, then download response.generateVideoResponse.generatedSamples[0].video.uri with the same header.

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: HeyGen API
entries.auth_hint: API key: X-Api-Key: <key> (bills to API plan). OAuth2: Authorization: Bearer <token> via https://api2.heygen.com/v1/oauth/token (bills to user's subscription credits).
entries.free_tier: no free API credits since Feb 2026; pay-as-you-go from $5, $0.50-$0.99/credit. Free plan (3 videos/mo) exists but is for the web app, not standalone API.
entries.desc_en: Create AI avatar/talking-head videos from text or audio, manage avatars and voices, via REST API.
entries.notes: Official remote MCP server uses OAuth (no API key needed) and spends the user's plan credits directly, separate from API-key billing.

rate_limits.summary: Pay-As-You-Go: 10 concurrent workflows (Enterprise 20, burst up to +50); 429 with Retry-After when exceeded

async_jobs.how: Poll the session/video (GET) until video_url is ready, or pass callback_url / register webhooks

call.async: Poll GET https://api.heygen.com/v3/video-agents/{session_id} until data.video_id is set, then GET https://api.heygen.com/v3/videos/{video_id} until status is completed and read video_url; or pass callback_url for a webhook.
call.operation: create an avatar video from a prompt (Video Agent)

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Klap API
entries.free_tier: Paid only; usage-based, billed monthly per operation (Generate Short $0.32, Video Input $0.44, Export $0.48); no free API credits stated
entries.desc_en: Automatically turn long videos into short clips with captions and reframing via REST API.

async_jobs.how: POST /tasks/video-to-shorts returns a task; poll GET /v2/tasks/{task_id} until status ready or error

call.async: Async: poll GET https://api.klap.app/v2/tasks/{task_id} while status == 'processing'; when done, output_id is the folder: list clips with GET /v2/projects/{folder_id}, export with POST /v2/projects/{folder_id}/{project_id}/exports and poll GET /v2/projects/{folder_id}/{project_id}/exports/{export_id} until src_url is ready
call.operation: submit a long video to be cut into short clips

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Kling AI API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> (create at kling.ai/dev/api-key); legacy Access/Secret Key pairs need a client-signed HS256 JWT instead
entries.free_tier: Paid only; prepaid credit packages from $0.14/unit, e.g. 5,000 units/$700, 180-day validity; a Trial Resource Package for integration testing is offered
entries.desc_en: Generate text-to-video, image-to-video, lip-sync and video effects via REST API with a Bearer API key.
entries.notes: New versioned endpoints (e.g. /text-to-video/kling-2.6) take a plain API key; the older Access/Secret key pair with a client-built JWT is legacy (model_name-parameter endpoints).

rate_limits.summary: Concurrency cap per account, model version and resource package; over-limit returns code 1303

async_jobs.how: Create task returns task id; query task status, or set callback_url for status notifications

call.operation: generate a video from a text prompt (Kling 2.6)
call.example: curl -X POST https://api-singapore.klingai.com/text-to-video/kling-2.6 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KLING_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"A girl sat on the train, looking out the window","settings":{"resolution":"720p","duration":5}}'
call.async: poll GET https://api-singapore.klingai.com/tasks?task_ids={id} until data[0].status is succeeded; video at data[0].outputs[0].url (kept 30 days)

unit_price.summary: Kling 2.6 720p (no audio): 0.3 units/s ($0.042/s), 5 s video = 1.5 units ($0.21); 1 unit = $0.14

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Luma AI Dream Machine API
entries.free_tier: Paid only; pay per video, e.g. Ray 3.2 5s text/image-to-video $0.15 (540p) / $0.30 (720p) / $1.20 (1080p), $5,000/mo cap on default Build tier
entries.desc_en: Generate and extend AI videos from text or start/end keyframe images via async REST API (Ray 3.2).
entries.notes: The Luma Agents API (https://agents.lumalabs.ai/v1) supersedes the older Dream Machine API. API credits are separate from Dream Machine subscription credits; failed generations are refunded.

rate_limits.summary: Build tier: Ray video 10 concurrent generations, 20 create requests/min; Photon image 40 concurrent, 80/min; $5,000/month usage cap

async_jobs.how: POST /generations returns an id; poll GET /generations/{id} until ready, or pass callback_url

call.operation: generate a video from a text prompt (Dream Machine API, Ray 2)
call.example: curl -X POST https://api.lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/v1/generations/video -H "Authorization: Bearer $LUMA_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"prompt":"A serene lake surrounded by mountains at sunset","aspect_ratio":"16:9","model":"ray-2"}'
call.async: poll GET https://api.lumalabs.ai/dream-machine/v1/generations/{id} until state is completed or failed (or pass callback_url)

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: MiniMax Hailuo API
entries.free_tier: new accounts get 50 signup credits (~1 short clip); 5s video costs ~45-70 credits, 1000 credits=$1
entries.desc_en: Async text-to-video, image-to-video and subject-reference video generation via REST API, up to 1080p.
entries.notes: Region-specific hosts/keys: platform.minimax.io / api.minimax.io vs intl.minimaxi.com for international accounts - key and host must match.

rate_limits.summary: Video: Hailuo series 20 RPM; MiniMax-H3 (v2) 300 RPM, 30 in-flight tasks

async_jobs.how: Create task returns task_id; poll Query Video Generation Task, then download file; optional callback_url

call.async: Poll GET https://api.minimax.io/v1/query/video_generation?task_id={task_id} until status is 'Success' (gives file_id), then GET https://api.minimax.io/v1/files/retrieve?file_id={file_id} for file.download_url; or pass callback_url to receive status pushes
call.example: curl -X POST https://api.minimax.io/v1/video_generation -H "Authorization: Bearer $MINIMAX_API_KEY" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model": "MiniMax-Hailuo-2.3", "prompt": "A cat walking on a beach at sunset"}'

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: PixVerse API
entries.auth_hint: API-KEY: <key> header plus a unique Ai-trace-id (UUID) header per request
entries.free_tier: Paid only; prepaid credits from $10, $1 = 5 videos (v6, 720p, 5s, no audio)
entries.desc_en: Generate text-to-video, image-to-video, transition and fusion clips (360p-1080p) via REST API.
entries.notes: Developer API credit pool (Essential/Scale/Business) is separate from consumer subscription plans.

auth_scheme.name: API-KEY
auth_scheme.format: API-KEY: <API_KEY> (plus unique Ai-trace-id UUID header per request)

rate_limits.summary: Concurrent generating tasks by membership: Free 3, Essential 15, Scale 20, Business 25

async_jobs.how: Generate returns video_id; poll GET /openapi/v2/video/result/{id} (status 5 generating, 1 done) or use webhook

call.async: Poll GET https://app-api.pixverse.ai/openapi/v2/video/result/{video_id} (API-KEY + a new Ai-trace-id header) until Resp.status = 1 (5 = generating, 7 = moderation failed, 8 = failed), then read Resp.url. Webhooks are also supported.

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Runway API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> plus required X-Runway-Version header
entries.free_tier: no free tier; $10 minimum credit top-up, $0.01/credit
entries.desc_en: Generate and edit images/video (Gen-4.5) via async task-based REST API: submit, poll, download.
entries.notes: Docs site also offers /llms-small.txt and /llms-full.txt (not a plain llms.txt). Generation MCP is mcp.runwayml.com/mcp; a separate dev.runwayml.com/mcp (OAuth) only covers Developer Portal tasks, model routers and docs.

rate_limits.summary: Per-model, per-organization concurrency and daily generation limits set by usage tier; tier up by adding credits over time; excess tasks THROTTLED (queued)

async_jobs.how: Generation endpoints return a task; poll GET /v1/tasks/{id} until status is terminal

call.operation: generate a video from an image and a prompt (Gen-4.5)
call.example: curl -X POST https://api.dev.runwayml.com/v1/image_to_video -H "Authorization: Bearer $RUNWAYML_API_SECRET" -H "X-Runway-Version: 2024-11-06" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"promptImage":"https://example.com/image.jpg","promptText":"A timelapse on a sunny day","model":"gen4.5","ratio":"1280:720","duration":5}'
call.async: poll GET https://api.dev.runwayml.com/v1/tasks/{id} until status is SUCCEEDED or FAILED; video URLs in output

unit_price.summary: Gen-4.5 video: 12 credits per second ($0.12/s, $0.60 per 5 s clip); 1 credit = $0.01

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Shotstack API
entries.free_tier: Trial: 10 free credits one-time (valid 30 days), then pay-as-you-go or subscription; stage sandbox (https://api.shotstack.io/edit/stage) for development, v1 production without watermarks
entries.desc_en: Compose Edit JSON timelines to programmatically render, edit, and template videos, images and audio.
entries.notes: Separate stage (sandbox, watermarked) and production API keys; MCP server is in beta.

async_jobs.how: POST /render returns an id; poll GET /render/{id} or set a callback URL

call.operation: render a video from an Edit JSON timeline
call.async: poll GET https://api.shotstack.io/edit/{version}/render/{id} until response.status is done, then read response.url

unit_price.summary: 1 credit = 1 minute of rendered video (or 10 images); pay-as-you-go $0.30/min ($75 one-time purchase), subscription from $0.20/min ($39/mo for 200 credits)

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Synthesia API
entries.free_tier: Paid only; API access requires the Creator plan or above
entries.desc_en: Generate AI avatar talking-head videos from text scripts via REST API; supports custom avatars and voices.
entries.notes: API access tied to paid plans; base URL https://api.synthesia.io/v2. Hosted MCP is in public beta and uses per-user OAuth.

rate_limits.summary: Creator (Tier 3): 60 req/min, 300/hour, 1,000/day writes per endpoint; 30 test videos/day; Enterprise tiers higher

async_jobs.how: POST /v2/videos returns id; poll GET /v2/videos/{id} for status or subscribe to webhooks

call.async: Poll GET https://api.synthesia.io/v2/videos/{id} until status is complete, then download from the time-limited `download` URL; or configure a webhook.
call.operation: create an avatar video from a script

uptime.up_means: host reachable: HTTP < 500, even 401/404; not a test of any endpoint

entries.name: Tavus API
entries.free_tier: Free tier: Free plan with 25 min of conversational video and 5 min of video generation per month, full API access, 25 stock replicas; Starter $59/mo
entries.desc_en: Create AI video replicas and real-time conversational video agents (CVI) via REST API.
entries.notes: llms_txt found at /llms-full.txt rather than /llms.txt exactly. The hosted MCP uses OAuth via the PAL Maker; never put a Tavus API key in the MCP client config.

free_plan.quota: 25 min conversational video + 5 min video generation

call.operation: start a real-time conversational video session (CVI)

unit_price.summary: CVI conversation overage $0.37/min (Starter, $59/mo) or $0.32/min (Growth, $397/mo), rounded to 6 s; video generation overage $1/min on Starter
